history.summary: A small neighbourhood temple on JLN Hospital Road at Kala Bagh, Ajmer - about 1.45 km from Ajmer Junction railway station. It is a mid-road Devi shrine of Goddess Ambe (Durga), described in local listings as a clean, well-maintained devotional stop with a 4.7/5 local rating; reviews note limited parking and no space to enter inside. No published history, builder, festival or timing details could be found - all fields for this record are thinly sourced and should be treated as provisional (verify).

name: Ambe Mata Mandir
town_description: Ajmer, in central Rajasthan, is one of the state's oldest cities - founded by Chauhan king Ajaypal, seat of the Chauhan dynasty, home to the Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti, Taragarh Fort, Ana Sagar lake and the Jain pilgrimage centre of Soniji Ki Nasiyan. It is a major rail junction and a gateway to the pilgrimage town of Pushkar, 15 km away.
